step1.logged_in_as: Bot verified successfully! Logged in as

step2.description: Choose how your bot should operate across your Discord servers.

step3.embed_help: If Yes, bot messages will use rich Discord embeds.

step4.title: Step 4: Web Panel
step4.oauth_help: The web panel requires Discord OAuth2 to authenticate staff members. Make sure to add the Redirect URL below to your OAuth2 Redirect URIs in the Discord Developer Portal.

step5.title: Step 5: Language
step5.bot_status_help: Displayed under the bot's name in the member list.
step5.welcome_placeholder: e.g. Thank you for contacting support! A staff member will be with you shortly.

step5.close_placeholder: e.g. Your ticket has been closed.
